Indicator 16 measures the proportion of newly diagnosed atrial fibrillation patients who develop heart failure within one year across [[danmark|Danmark]] and its five regions [^src1]. According to the data for the 2021/22 period, the national proportion was 6.5% (95% CI: 6.1-6.8) [^src1]. None of the geographical entities met the required clinical standard, as the "Standard opfyldt" (Standard met) metric was recorded at 0% for all regions and the national average [^src1].

For the 2021/22 period, [[region-sjaelland|Region Sjælland]] had the highest proportion of patients developing heart failure at 7.4%, followed by [[region-hovedstaden|Region Hovedstaden]] at 7.1% [^src1]. The lowest proportions were observed in [[region-midtjylland|Region Midtjylland]] at 5.7% and [[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland]] at 5.8% [^src1]. [[region-syddanmark|Region Syddanmark]] recorded a rate of 6.1%, sitting just below the national average [^src1].

Although this data is drawn from a single table section, the included historical columns reveal a consistent downward trajectory in heart failure complications across all regions over the three measured periods [^src1]. Nationally, the proportion decreased from 9.0% in 2019/20 to 7.9% in 2020/21, before reaching 6.5% in 2021/22 [^src1]. This pattern of improvement is mirrored regionally; for example, [[region-sjaelland|Region Sjælland]] dropped from 9.6% in 2019/20 to 7.4% in 2021/22, while [[region-midtjylland|Region Midtjylland]] fell from 8.6% to 5.7% over the same timeframe [^src1]. While the absolute number of patients in the denominator fluctuates slightly year over year, the steady reduction in the percentage of heart failure complications indicates a systemic improvement in post-diagnosis care across the Danish healthcare regions [^src1].

Entities: danmark, region-hovedstaden, region-sjaelland, region-syddanmark, region-midtjylland, region-nordjylland

Summary: Tabellen sammenligner andelen af nydiagnosticerede atrieflimren-patienter, der udvikler hjertesvigt inden for ét år, på nationalt og regionalt niveau for perioden 01.07.2021–30.06.2022, og viser en landsomfattende andel på 6,5 % med regional variation fra 5,7 % (Midtjylland) til 7,4 % (Sjælland).
